scenario: A three-step chain `A then B within 10_s then C within 10_s` fires for A, B and C whose `ts` (0, 5, 10 ns) are each strictly after the one before and within the bound (LTHE.2.2.2). The expectation states one firing, so it pins that the chain fires exactly once. Every gap is inside both windows, so the vector cannot tell which `then` each `within` binds to (LTHE.2.3.1), and no out-of-order case is stepped.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

schema B scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

schema C scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

rule chain:
    A
    then B within 10_s
    then C within 10_s
->
    log info "chain"
